title: Relationship Manager Small Enterprises
description:
**Core Responsibilities**
**Revenue Generation**
* Achieve Banks objective in terms of earnings, assets, liabilities, credit quality etc. as per agreed budgets / targets from client relationship across all product groups


**Relationship Management**
* Seek and acquire new client relationships by understanding the customers financial needs and provide suitable solutions in terms of providing bank products and services
* Manage the client relationships by handling activities ranging from identifying clients financial needs, advising, structuring the deal, preparing the terms and conditions and closing the deal
* Assess banking needs and risks for clients and manage client relationships accordingly to optimize risk\-reward for the Bank


**Communication/PR of Bank’s products**
* Undertakes brand communication initiatives for designated products
* Communicates product positioning messaging that differentiates YES Bank’s products in the market


**Market Research**
* Illustrates understanding of consumers, competition and current market conditions through primary and secondary research


**Credit Appraisal**
* Appraisal of the proposals involving detailed analysis of Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Financial Ratios, Cash Flows, Management Risk, Industry Risk, Economic conditions


**Documentation and Compliance**
* To maintain high quality standards of documentation, client communication, process compliance, ongoing basis with product partners / OSD / Risk Management and other Relationship Management group


**Self\-Management Responsibilities**
* Defines performance goals at the start of the year in discussion with the reporting manager and ensures that the goals are monitored and achieved during the course of the year.
* Takes ownership of his/her own learning agenda by identifying development needs in consultation with the reporting manager and working towards bridging the gaps through various means which go beyond just training.
* Understands the competencies relevant to his/her role, and works towards displaying as well as developing these effectively.


 Keeps abreast of relevant professional/industry developments, new techniques and current issues through continued education and professional networks.
   

  

**Risk And Internal Control Responsibilities**
* Follows risk policy and processes to mitigate the operational, regulatory, financial, informational, reputational and audit risks as instructed by departmental manager.


 Executes the established internal control systems and compiles the relevant information for departmental audits, as necessary.

title: Lead Generation Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Truzon Solar is a leading solar energy solutions provider in India, with over 18 years of experience and more than 15,000 satisfied customers across residential, industrial, and commercial sectors. The company delivers rooftop systems, ground\-mounted solar projects, and PM\-KUSUM solutions for farmers, helping clients lower energy costs and reduce their carbon footprint. With a workforce of 650\+ in\-house employees, strong after\-sales support, and advanced technology, Truzon Solar is committed to reliability and customer satisfaction. Supported by brand ambassador Mahesh Babu, the organization is on a path toward an ₹1,000 Crore revenue milestone and an IPO, driven by a vision to make clean energy accessible and become India’s most trusted solar energy brand.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Lead Generation Executive role based in Shirur. The Lead Generation Executive will identify and qualify new business leads through phone calls, emails, field visits, and digital channels, focusing on residential, commercial, and industrial solar prospects. The role involves conducting market research to understand customer segments, competitors, and regional trends, and maintaining accurate lead data in CRM or tracking tools. The executive will coordinate with the sales team to schedule meetings or site visits, share prospect information, and support follow\-up activities. Day\-to\-day responsibilities also include responding to inquiries, explaining Truzon Solar’s offerings, and contributing to lead\-generation campaigns to support revenue growth.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess skills in New Leads and Lead Generation to identify, nurture, and qualify potential customers.
* Candidates should possess skills in Market Research to analyze customer needs, competitor activities, and local market trends.
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills to interact effectively with prospects, explain solutions clearly, and build trust.
* Candidates should possess basic to intermediate Sales skills to support conversions, handle objections, and collaborate with the sales team.
* Relevant qualifications such as a diploma or bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field are preferred.
* Prior experience in lead generation, telesales, field sales, or solar/renewable energy is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Shirur, manage multiple leads, and use CRM or lead\-tracking tools efficiently.
* Strong work ethic, goal orientation, and willingness to learn about solar energy solutions.

title: Bid Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 SLK Group of Companies is a diversified and fast\-growing enterprise in India, with operations across facility management, automotive, infrastructure, manufacturing, renewable energy, and pharmaceuticals. The Group delivers customized, high\-quality solutions to commercial, residential, and industrial clients, supporting industrial growth and infrastructure development. Its portfolio includes automotive components, upcoming vehicle retail, premium residential projects, and essential manufactured products such as food colors, wall paints, and street lighting systems. SLK Group is also committed to clean energy through solar panels and windmills, and supplies regulated pharmaceutical products. Guided by customer focus, technology\-driven innovation, and ethical business practices, the Group positions itself as a trusted, forward\-looking organization for long\-term careers.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Bid Specialist role based in Pimpri Chinchwad. The Bid Specialist will manage end\-to\-end bid and tender processes, including identifying opportunities, reviewing tender documents, and coordinating internal inputs to develop competitive proposals. Day\-to\-day work includes preparing and structuring bid responses, drafting and refining technical and commercial proposals, and ensuring compliance with client requirements and company standards. The role involves close collaboration with sales, operations, finance, and technical teams to gather accurate information and costings, as well as maintaining bid trackers, documentation, and submission timelines. The Bid Specialist will also support post\-submission follow\-ups, respond to clarifications, and contribute to continuous improvement of bidding strategies and templates.
 



  





  





 ANNUAL CTC :\- 7,80,000 /\-
 



  





  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong skills in Bid Processes and Tender Management, including familiarity with government and private sector tendering.
* Candidates should possess hands\-on experience in Bid Preparation and Proposal Writing, with the ability to tailor responses to diverse industry sectors.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including clear written business English and effective stakeholder coordination.
* Experience with documentation control, data analysis, and MS Office (especially Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) is highly beneficial.
* Attention to detail, time management, and the ability to work under strict deadlines in a structured, process\-driven environment are essential.
* A bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, commerce, or a related field is preferred; prior experience in bidding or tender coordination is an advantage.
* Understanding of facility management, infrastructure, manufacturing, automotive, or renewable energy sectors will be considered an added benefit.

title: Account Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 SLK Group of Companies is a diversified and fast\-growing enterprise in India, operating across facility management, automotive, infrastructure, manufacturing, renewable energy, and pharmaceuticals. The Group delivers efficient and customized facility management solutions to commercial, residential, and industrial clients, and manufactures automotive components aligned with global quality standards while expanding into vehicle retail and customer services. In infrastructure, SLK develops premium residential projects that emphasize modern design, strong construction, and sustainable practices. Its manufacturing portfolio includes food colors, wall paints, street lighting systems, solar panels, and windmills, supporting both industrial and public infrastructure needs as well as clean energy adoption. Guided by customer focus, technology\-driven innovation, and ethical business practices, SLK Group positions itself as a trusted, forward\-looking organization with a growing presence across diverse sectors.
 



  





  





 ANNUAL CTC :\- 6,60,000/\-
 



  





  





**Role Description** 
 The Account Manager role at SLK Group of Companies is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Pimpri Chinchwad. The Account Manager will manage day\-to\-day relationships with assigned clients, acting as the primary point of contact for inquiries, requests, and issue resolution. This role includes understanding client requirements, preparing proposals and quotations, coordinating service delivery with internal teams, and ensuring contractual obligations are met. The Account Manager will monitor account performance, track key metrics, and prepare regular reports and updates for clients and management. Additional responsibilities include identifying growth opportunities within existing accounts, supporting collections and invoicing, maintaining accurate records in internal systems, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to improve service quality and customer satisfaction.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong client relationship management skills, including stakeholder communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution.
* Experience in account planning, sales support, and business development within services, manufacturing, or related industries.
* Proficiency in documentation, reporting, and basic data analysis using tools such as MS Excel, Word, and presentation software.
* Ability to coordinate with operations, finance, and service teams to ensure timely delivery, billing, and issue closure.
* Solid organizational and time management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple accounts simultaneously.
* Comfort working on\-site in Pimpri Chinchwad and engaging regularly with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, engineering, or a related field; relevant account management or customer service experience preferred.
* Knowledge of sectors such as facility management, automotive, infrastructure, manufacturing, or renewable energy is an advantage.
* Professional work ethic, integrity, and a commitment to providing high\-quality, customer\-focused service.
